title.narrative: UNICEF helped to (1) improve targeting of spending for children through Institutionalizing child budgeting in 11 states and adopting a standard approach for capturing spending on children; (2) advocating with Central Finance Commission (CFC) and State Finance Commissions (SFCs) respectively for child focused enhanced devolution. and (3) develop an innovative financing model to mobilize resources from unconventional sources. UNICEF technical support institutionalized a standardized approach to estimating spending on children by multiple Ministries. Developed the office-wide draft Financing for Children (F4C) approach towards sustainable financing for children.
